runtimeDecision.reason: Incomplete energy-to-display chain; unvalidated escapement contacts and spring deformation. The product is static construction exploration.

faceFlip.reviewStatus: Maker animation visually inspected; CAD endpoint correspondence numerically verified. Not a physical service or collision certification.
observations: Exact half-second frames: upper attachment withdraws around 9–10 s; lower around 10.5–11 s; complete case turns around 11–13 s; lower attachment seats around 13.5–14 s; upper around 16–17 s.
Attachments retain their orientation in the viewing frame; the case, crown and complete movement turn across the crown/9–3 axis.

Maker correspondence names this X. CAD crown lies at positive X (crown occurrence translation X=20 mm); the two attachment packets lie along ±Y and the faces normal to ±Z. This establishes CAD X, not the previous lug-local Y interpretation.

coordinateMapping.endpointAudit: All 18 transformed leaves match an original opposite-end occurrence with identical definition ID. Audited source matrices are used exactly at endpoints; upper child 4 now maps to child 5, lower child 9 to child 10. The assembled visible set is unchanged; only identical-instance correspondence changes.

implementation.referenceFrame: Source CAD stays fixed. Apply the same inverse X rotation to the observer position/target/up and to the lug packets. In this fixed-attachment viewing frame the entire case turns and the attachments translate without rotating. Source buffers and immutable assembled matrices remain unchanged.
implementation.sequence: Upper clears, lower clears, case turns 180 degrees, lower reseats, upper reseats. Symmetric phase path supports continuous interrupted reversals from any displayed phase.
implementation.configuration: Case-hidden flips use the same case-turn clock. Optional case loading/visibility does not restart it. Dial/hand/material preferences remain independent. Disassembly offsets remain separate; requested camera refits defer until turnover ends. Explicit navigation supersedes its viewing frame.
implementation.reducedMotion: One update moves camera and fitted poses to the requested exact endpoint, including a preference change during playback.
implementation.lockingPins: Four ring-mounted d72 pins remain on their source seats in the turning case; their release is not resolved by the video. Previous illustrative outward pin motion is removed.

interpretations: The 8 mm clearance and 1.8 second UI duration are authored, not measured from the presentation video.
The pivot Z is the midpoint validated by source counterpart transforms, not a measured physical hinge. No permanent case hinge is claimed.
The animation demonstrates a released case being turned. Detailed lock actuation, strap flex, tools, collisions and tolerances are not simulated.
Disassembly remains an illustrative explorer mode; combining it with Flip is not a physical assembly procedure.
